Support for traveling believers makes truth practical while exclusion reveals a conflict over authority

Verse 5 praises Gaius for what he does for brothers who are strangers. Verse 7 explains their need. They went out for the Name and accepted nothing from the Gentiles. Verse 8 gives the duty that follows: we “ought to receive such.” It also gives the host a title. Those who support them are fellow workers for the truth. Verses 9–10 show the opposite: Diotrephes refuses the brothers and stops others.
